units.source_text: 房檐紧接房檐，屋顶上的雪除了弄到马路当中以外，别无他处可以弃置了。

en.t: With the eaves pressed close together, there was nowhere to throw the snow from the roofs except into the middle of the road.

units.source_text: 实际上是将雪从大屋顶上高高抛起来扔到马路正中的雪堤上。

en.t: In practice, they flung the snow high from the broad roofs onto the snow embankment in the very center of the road.

units.source_text: 要到马路对过，就得挖通雪堤，修成一条条隧道。

en.t: To get to the other side of the road, people had to dig through the snow bank and make tunnel after tunnel.

units.source_text: 这些地方管它叫做“钻胎内涵洞”。

en.t: In this region, they called those passages going through the womb.
